text: Halleluyah! I will wholeheartedly give thanks to ADONAI in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
The deeds of ADONAI are great, greatly desired by all who enjoy them.
His work is full of majesty and splendor, and his righteousness continues forever.
He has gained renown for his wonders. ADONAI is merciful and compassionate.
He gives food to those who fear him. He remembers his covenant forever.
He shows his people how powerfully he works by giving them the nations as their heritage.
The works of his hands are truth and justice; all his precepts can be trusted.
They have been established forever and ever, to be carried out truly and honestly.
He sent redemption to his people and decreed that his covenant should last forever. His name is holy and fearsome —
the first and foremost point of wisdom is the fear of ADONAI; all those living by it gain good common sense. His praise stands forever.
